protocol_assessment: Changes govern harness execution-output storage; no runtime, DB table, transaction command owner, SafetyRegistry/S01 lock order or T1-T8 atomic boundary changes. No Evidence Admission, production/shadow, provider command authority or planned/actual semantics change is required.

Default gzip remains supported; XZ decoder accepts only declared single CRC64 XZ streams with EOF/no trailing bytes, fixed 64MiB memory bound, raw length plus one output bound and exact stored/raw integrity. Codec selection has no extension/fallback or archive delegation.

Fresh conversion requires actual protected-base ancestor of source and unchanged regular source/HEAD/working snapshots; absent base paths, selected ownership and immutable original-to-replacement records prevent borrowed historical authority.

Retained maps require committed byte identity before first base import, original admission/unique merge-base, no protected-path use during base advancement, original-prefix audit and every actual-base descendant containing source also containing original admission. Reversed parents and identical late recreation reject.

Relocation binds distinct original-envelope-hash filenames under the same owner/subtree; destination absence is checked on every admitting parent. Retirement is accounted and current shared refs preserve required payloads. Both original and replacement sides remain protected; ordinary audit mappings cannot supply execution output.

Inherited maps and source/replacement snapshots are revalidated globally and per intervening parent/revision. Aliased/encoded/wrapped/transient foreign storage is classified globally. Narrow binary classifier deferral requires exact same-revision bound payload proof and does not suppress integrity/size failures.

Conversion is implementation and cannot enter tested/review bookkeeping suffixes. Missing-current generic review availability consults only the recorded reviewed SHA, while present invalid artifacts/parents and unavailable sources reject; selected command/tested/exit/PASS/freshness proof is unchanged.

Shared storage bytes retain independent execution provenance. C17 real stdout, clean tested manifest, collection identities, every setup/call/teardown report and JUnit agree. Historical failed/interrupted executions provide no final PASS credit.
